newsitem.title: FINLAND: PK Cables CEO sees telecoms sales growth.
newsitem.headline: PK Cables CEO sees telecoms sales growth.

text.p: Finnish industrial wiring group PK Cables Oy expects net sales in its telecoms related business growing 25-30 percent in 1997, the group's chief executive said on Friday.
Newly listed PK Cables is aiming for group net sales growth to 500 million markka within three to five years, from 260 million in 1996, CEO Tom Hakalax told Reuters in an interview.
"Net sales growth of about 25-30 percent in our telecoms equipment business this year would be normal and manageable," he said.
